_comment: Sample questionnaire content. Edit this file to change the questions used to SEED the database on first run. After the first run, questions live in the database and are edited from the /admin page. To re-seed from this file, stop the app, delete data/responses.db, and start again. 'creatorAnswer' is your own answer ("A" or "B") and is never sent to respondents' browsers. Media (image/video) is optional — leave as empty strings for none. There is no built-in meaning to A vs B; sides can be reordered freely without affecting scoring.

questions.title: When you watch TV or a film
questions.answerA: I give it my full attention and just watch
questions.answerB: I usually have my phone or something else on the go too

questions.title: Making a cup of tea or coffee
questions.answerA: I make it and drink it while it's hot
questions.answerB: I make it, get distracted, and find it stone cold later

questions.title: Getting ready to leave the house
questions.answerA: I get ready in a steady order, one thing at a time
questions.answerB: I start five things at once and hope they all finish

questions.title: Doing the food shop
questions.answerA: I follow a list, aisle by aisle
questions.answerB: I wander and grab whatever catches my eye

questions.title: Reading a book
questions.answerA: I read one book from start to finish
questions.answerB: I've got three or four on the go at once
